description: The model registry: one row per model, holding every per-model fact. Extend it by adding a file of the same shape and naming it in ANAMNESIS_MODELS, never by editing this one - a row here is what banked data was produced under. anamnesis/config/models.py reads it.

8b.name: 8b
8b.notes: Proportional depth sampling at 0%, 25%, 50%, 63%, 75%, 88%, 97%, denser through 60-80% where mode signal concentrates. The end-of-generation tokens are end-of-text, end-of-message and end-of-turn.

70b.name: 70b
70b.notes: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct; the 8B-Instruct row's decode settings and end-of-generation tokens; sampled layers by the 8B fractional-depth rule (0, 25, 50, 63, 75, 88%, top anchored).

3b.name: 3b
3b.notes: The end-of-generation tokens are end-of-text and end-of-turn; this checkpoint has no end-of-message token. Its corpus and calibration live in the tree the legacy data root names, which is why calibration_root is legacy rather than outputs.

olmo2-7b.name: olmo2-7b
olmo2-7b.notes: A base checkpoint with no chat template: bare prompts only, and no system prompt. Full multi-head attention, so the grouped-query caveat about head indexing does not apply. Query and key RMSNorm sit between the projections and RoPE, so k_proj hooks capture pre-norm pre-RoPE keys: position-free holds, but the substrate is not a Llama checkpoint's post-projection keys.

gemma3-27b.name: gemma3-27b
gemma3-27b.notes: A multimodal wrapper class, so decoder layers resolve through the loader's layer-finding helper rather than a fixed attribute path. Attention interleaves five local sliding-window layers to one global layer, global at every sixth: the sampled layers prefer global ones, with layer 0 kept local as the early-band anchor. The decode parameters are the model card's native sampling.

dsv2-lite.name: dsv2-lite
dsv2-lite.notes: A mixture-of-experts checkpoint: two shared and sixty-four routed experts, greedy top-6, layer 0 a dense MLP and layers 1-26 routed. Load it with trust_remote_code=False - the bundled remote code puts gate projections per expert, which the routing hooks do not target. Attention is latent: the keys source is the position-free part of the fused key/value projection, sliced in anamnesis/extraction/model_loader.py. With no separate key or value projection module, values and queries are not part of this checkpoint's feature surface. num_attention_heads and num_kv_heads are the config's key/value head count, which the attention weights follow; the keys-source capture is the 512-wide latent, not these heads. head_dim is the value head width - query and key heads are 192 wide, 128 content dimensions and 64 positional ones. Sampled layers are proportional and mid-heavy; layer 0 is dense, so it yields no expert-routing features. The decode parameters are the checkpoint's own generation_config.json, which is colder than every other row here.
